scope: Ordered resident linear primitive graph for automorphism, public polynomial multiplication and native addition. Host metadata/lifetime validation only; complete S2C translator and encrypted graph validation outstanding.
cases: Five-step plain/add/plain/add/auto graph with reused tensor workspace, reused intermediate storage and exact last-use in-place addition; four-step selected in-place root. Reject malformed topology/descriptors, Q/delta mismatches, overflow, live-value overwrite, selected-output overwrite and corruption of future public plaintext/key tables.
evaluation_contract: Prevalidate all children/edges/global immutable buffers and live intermediates before launch; sequential child evaluations on one caller stream. No device allocation, transfer or synchronization; host metadata may allocate. Caller must synchronize after partial errors.
ubsan_scope: Current host CUDA source/test instrumented, unchanged host-instrumented Tensor Core object reused. Device/runtime code uninstrumented and device branches unexecuted.
